content.title: WATCH: Dunkin’ surprises youth baseball team with tickets to Conway Banana Ball games
content.text: CONWAY, SC (WMBF) - A well-known coffee chain recognized a Horry County youth baseball team for all their hard work. Dunkin’ surprised the North Myrtle Beach Chiefs All-Stars youth baseball team Saturday with 20 tickets to the Party Animals vs. Loco Beach Coconuts sellout games this weekend at Spring Brooks Stadium.The North Myrtle Beach Chiefs All-Stars were celebrated at the Conway Dunkin’ at 1477 Highway 544 for their recent championship win at the Diamond Youth Baseball World Series.Credit: Alliance Marketing PartnersRELATED COVERAGE: In addition, from 9 to 11 a.m., players stepped behind the counter to serve guests, take photos and sign autographs.WATCH: Dunkin’ surprises youth baseball team with tickets to Conway Banana Ball games(Alliance Marketing Partners)According to a news release, fans enjoyed Dunkin’ merchandise and $5 promotional gift card giveaways.The Party Animals and Loco Beach Coconuts faced off in a two-game series on Saturday and Sunday. The teams are in the Banana Ball Championship League.Banana Ball has become a staple of entertainment across the country over the last few years.Banana Ball has several signature rules that set it apart from traditional baseball, including a point-based inning system, no bunting, no mound visits, a strict game-time limit and a rule that a batter is out if a fan catches a foul ball.Dunkin’ is the official coffee and breakfast partner of the Banana Ball Championship League.Feel more informed, prepared, and connected with WMBF.
